reference.coordinate: current ego frame, full SE(3), x forward y left
reference.definition: unconstrained-intercept causal quadratic pose fit, exact frames -10..0, nominal 10Hz

p7_prediction.definition: raw first four state_hat outputs, no correction/rescaling; current ego vx vy ax ay
p7_prediction.supervision: same SE(3) quadratic fit, raw timestamp window <=1.001s, >=6 samples

time_metadata.nominal_time_s_definition: round((scene raw frame0 - session minimum raw frame0)*10)/10 + frame/10
time_metadata.session_raw_time_s_definition: raw_timestamp_ms/1000 - minimum raw scene frame0 in same session

scope.interpretation: Frozen P7 estimator transfer perturbation, not a retrained SDV2 image-state model, not a performance prediction.
